title: Content Repurposer with a House Voice
oneLiner: Turns one blog post into a thread, a LinkedIn post, and a newsletter blurb — voice rules packaged as a versioned skill.

args.title: Smoke test post
args.post: We spent three weeks migrating our build system and cut CI times from 40 minutes to 6. The surprising part was not the tooling - it was that half the time went to tests nobody remembered writing, which we deleted after checking coverage. The lesson: measure before you migrate, because the biggest win may be subtraction.
